An identification-link antenna for the Promin. Links the worn AR scanner to the Promin's processor. Install into the Promin. Not needed for the OSD scanner.
 
%c[255,235,205,110]FEATURES:
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Links the AR scanner to the Promin
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Required for the AR scanner path

Processes scan data from the identification scanner. Install into the Promin -- one process module at a time.
 
%c[255,235,205,110]FEATURES:
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Base scan time ~1.5 s
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Reveals faction
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Reveals distance

Processes scan data from the identification scanner. Install into the Promin -- one process module at a time.
 
%c[255,235,205,110]FEATURES:
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Base scan time ~1.0 s
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Reveals faction & distance
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]+ Relationship
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]+ Rank

Processes scan data from the identification scanner. Install into the Promin -- one process module at a time.
 
%c[255,235,205,110]FEATURES:

A worn AR scanner. Projects identification overlays onto targets in view (the usual on-entity UI). Worn on the bracer; needs the antenna + a process module installed in the Promin.
 
%c[255,235,205,110]FEATURES:
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Identify range ~10 m
%c[255,120,210,180] • %c[default]Shown ON entities (overlays)
